name: inspira-shimmer-button
title: Shimmer Button
blurb: Light sweep slides across button on loop.
description: A button with a continuously animated shimmer effect using a linear gradient that sweeps across from left to right.
use_when: You want a loading or attention-grabbing shimmer effect on a button.
avoid_when: When you need a clear, static CTA; the motion can distract from the action.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Shimmer is visual only. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
